pages.title: Park Fever
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Park Fever combines parking puzzles with passenger pickup. Release vehicles in an order that keeps their arrow directions clear, then bring them to the boarding area. Each vehicle needs passengers of the matching color, so freeing space and serving the queue are connected parts of clearing the lot.

pages.title: Eggy Beats
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Create a rhythm in Eggy Beats by tapping eggs that produce different sounds. Arrange your own musical patterns, listen to the result, and experiment with another combination. Play, clear, save, and load controls let you build and revisit your beats.

pages.title: Axe Throw
pages.creator: Hyper Rabbit Games
pages.description: Axe Throw challenges you to hit a target while explosive bombs interfere with your shot. Hold the axe, drag to line up your aim, and release to throw. Watch the moving hazards before committing, because hitting a bomb ends the attempt.

pages.title: Chicken Jump : A Tap Challenge
pages.creator: TheBottle
pages.description: Guide a chicken past hurdles in Chicken Jump : A Tap Challenge. Swipe upward to make it jump, choosing the moment carefully so it clears the obstacle. The levels revolve around timing each leap; a badly timed jump leaves the chicken colliding with a hurdle.

pages.title: Void Orbit
pages.creator: Neloyann
pages.description: Circle a central core in Void Orbit while avoiding incoming enemies. Tapping reverses your direction, giving you a way to change your approach to danger without leaving the orbit. Survive to collect points, and explore additional modes, skins, and themes through the menus.

pages.title: Supermarket Simulator: Dream Store
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Supermarket Simulator: Dream Store puts you in charge of building and running a shop. Place shelves, stock products, serve customers, and set prices. As the business expands, hire staff, manage their skills, and use discounts or promotions alongside new departments and decorations.

pages.title: Vice City Driver
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Explore a city behind the wheel of a sports car in Vice City Driver. Take on driving missions and speed, drift, and stunt challenges, with a dog accompanying you. Customize and upgrade the car, then use nitro to help overtake traffic and tackle the map's driving tests.

pages.title: Monster Arena
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Grow a roaming monster by eating fruit in Monster Arena. Steer around rival creatures and try to make them collide with your expanding body while avoiding their attacks. Choose an island and compete to become the first monster to reach full growth.

pages.title: Cryptogram
pages.creator: Wit Games
pages.description: Cryptogram turns an encrypted phrase into a letter puzzle. Each number stands for one letter throughout the message, so a solved substitution helps reveal other words. Enter letters into highlighted cells and use the emerging phrase to work toward the complete quotation, proverb, or fact.

pages.title: Street Traffic Racer
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Weave through highway traffic in Street Traffic Racer without crashing into slower vehicles. Choose from six cars and tackle three game modes across different landscapes. Replenishing nitro supports overtaking, while customization and performance upgrades let you adjust the cars between drives.

pages.title: Fashion Princess - Dress Up for Girls
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Fashion Princess - Dress Up for Girls blends outfit styling with fashion races judged on your finished look. Choose clothing and a hairstyle, then try to impress the judges. Collect crystals to unlock additional models, hairstyles, and dances for later styling attempts.

pages.title: Dye It Right: Color Picker
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Move colors to their proper places in Dye It Right: Color Picker. Pick up dye with the tool and apply it where the picture requires that color. Each artistic puzzle asks you to organize the colors into a correctly finished design.

pages.title: Mighty Run
pages.creator: Pkgames
pages.description: Mighty Run is a platform adventure built around jumping past obstacles and fighting enemies. Gather gifts as you move through each stage, then reach the diamond at the end to open the next level. Power-ups assist the journey, while arrow keys control movement and jumping.

pages.title: Sandwich Runner
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Stack food into a towering meal in Sandwich Runner. Collect ingredients such as steak, fried eggs, and sushi along the route to a waiting diner. Avoid rotten or moldy food that makes the diner ill, and watch how red peppers change the final reaction.

pages.title: Pop Culture Halloween Makeup
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Build a character-inspired Halloween look in Pop Culture Halloween Makeup. Experiment with hair, eye makeup, lipstick, and neck paint before pairing the result with clothing and accessories. The choices let you coordinate an entire costume look around the makeup you create.

pages.title: Pet Connect Match
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Pet Connect Match asks you to link identical animals until the board is empty. Choose between progressing through levels, playing against a time limit, or matching without that restriction. Scan the remaining pets for pairs and keep connecting them to clear the layout.

pages.title: Egg Hunt Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Catch falling eggs in Egg Hunt Mania and take a full basket to the shop. Selling eggs earns money for upgrades and sales multipliers, but each day also brings a required catch. Keep pace with the rising quota to make it through another day.

pages.title: Death Ball
pages.creator: Dorfer Games OU
pages.description: Swing and throw a ball to cause destruction in Death Ball. Attack other players while sending people and tables flying around the scene. Use WASD to move and the mouse to attack as you line up another disruptive hit.

pages.title: BFFs High School First Date Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Style a group of friends for a school date in BFFs High School First Date Look. Browse outfits, hairstyles, and accessories, then combine them into a complete appearance for each friend. Experiment with different combinations to give the characters individual looks for their dates.

pages.title: Melodic Tiles
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Clear groups of identical pieces in Melodic Tiles, a music-themed tile puzzle. Unblock tiles to make further matches and empty the playing field. Rehearsal mode lets you practice freely, while Concert mode connects your matching to the beat of the music.

pages.title: DOP2 Jailbreak
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: DOP2 Jailbreak uses erasing as the solution to a series of escape puzzles. Look at each scene and remove the detail that changes the situation for Stickman and his girlfriend. The diamond theft and police pursuit lead to puzzles with unexpected, comic outcomes.

pages.title: Fluffy Cubes
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Fluffy Cubes is a block puzzle where clicking cubes reduces them toward their nearest neighbors. Work through the cube arrangements, collect stars, and unlock new items while adding color to the world. Zoom controls let you adjust your view of the puzzle.

pages.title: End of War
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Rebuild a devastated world in End of War. Rescue people trapped beneath rubble and bring survivors together to restore houses, factories, and forests. Your task is to turn ruined settlements back into functioning cities through reconstruction and the recovery of their surroundings.

pages.title: Cut 3D
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Follow timber from the forest to a finished house in Cut 3D. Saw trees, process the wood into boards, and use the materials for construction. The game connects lumber work with building, making each stage of producing a home part of the task.

pages.title: Black Friday Shopping Spree
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Black Friday Shopping Spree lets you help a princess choose new clothes during a sale. Explore prom, urban, and sportswear options, then put together outfits that suit each style. Compare the available pieces and create different looks for her shopping trip.

pages.title: Road Climb Racer
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Drive Tom over steep terrain in Road Climb Racer, balancing progress with opportunities to perform flips. Compete against other racers and collect coins across varied environments. Spend earnings on different cars and upgrades that improve speed, acceleration, and jumping ability for later challenges.

pages.title: Ninja In Cape
pages.creator: UznGames
pages.description: Ninja In Cape follows an armed ninja through a series of action levels. Make your way across each stage and use the available weapons against enemies blocking the route. The adventure centers on completing the course while handling the threats encountered along it.

pages.title: Zombie Shooter 3D
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Fight crowds of undead in Zombie Shooter 3D, set in a closed, dark forest. Clear the area using an arsenal that includes pistols, automatic guns, grenades, shotguns, and heavier weapons. Keep attacking the approaching zombies as you work to eliminate the infestation.

pages.title: Marie Prepares Treat
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Help a princess prepare a homemade surprise in Marie Prepares Treat. Make chocolates using different varieties and decorations, then bake and decorate cupcakes. Finish the preparations by choosing a festive dress and a drink to accompany the sweets she has made.

pages.title: Mad Burger 3
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Launch a burger across the Wild West in Mad Burger 3. Cook it, improve the recipe with new ingredients, and work on sending it farther with stronger kicks and skills. Hungry residents and bandits can interrupt its journey before it reaches the intended destination.

pages.title: Paper Fold Online
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Paper Fold Online asks you to turn folded sections of paper into a complete picture. Select the parts in the right sequence so they overlap correctly. Each puzzle depends on the order of your folds, gradually revealing the illustration as the pieces fall into place.

pages.title: Battle Soccer Arena
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Battle Soccer Arena features three-player teams competing without goalkeepers. Choose national sides and play against the computer or a friend. With no dedicated keeper guarding either end, you need to balance moving the ball forward with protecting the open goal.

pages.title: Mad Mad Unicorn
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Control a hostile flying unicorn in Mad Mad Unicorn. Attack birds while avoiding missiles sent in from different directions by humans trying to stop you. A magical carrot offers protection against those weapons, adding another element to the airborne chase.

pages.title: Scary Midnight Hidden Bats
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Search eerie scenes for concealed shapes in Scary Midnight Hidden Bats. Find ten bats in each image before the timer expires. Repeated incorrect clicks remove extra time, so inspect the details carefully as you work through the eight levels.

pages.title: Ella and Anna Spring Break
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Ella and Anna Spring Break is a dress-up game about preparing two friends for a beach vacation. Choose their holiday looks and coordinate the available fashion pieces. Help both characters get ready for the trip by putting together outfits for their spring break plans.

pages.title: Robot Wars
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Draw a fighting vehicle in Robot Wars, then take your creation into a duel. Your drawing shapes the chariot you use against an enemy, connecting design with combat. Tap to attack and keep fighting as you try to become the winner.

pages.title: Frog Road
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Help a frog cross busy streets in Frog Road. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and choose a safe moment to enter each stretch of traffic. Trucks and other road hazards threaten the crossing, making careful movement central to keeping the frog alive.

pages.title: Zumba Challenge
pages.creator: Bubble Shooter
pages.description: Zumba Challenge has you fire colored bubbles into an advancing chain. Form groups of at least three matching bubbles to remove them before they reach the end of the track. Clearing the chain opens the next stage, with the layouts growing more demanding along the way.

pages.title: Spider Trump
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Swing a ragdoll politician through hazardous courses in Spider Trump. Shoot webs to move past obstacles and reach the destination while preserving as much of the character's body as possible. Physics-driven movement turns each level into a test of how you time your swings.

pages.title: Brake Down
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Control a moving circle's timing in Brake Down. Tap to apply the brake and adjust when it passes the obstacles ahead. The task is to travel through the hazards without a collision, using pauses to make room for a safe passage.

pages.title: Cool Castle Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Cool Castle Match 3 turns medieval castles into matching pieces. Find matching groups on the board and work toward a higher score. The castle setting gives the puzzle its theme as you search the layout for useful combinations.

pages.title: Flying Car Extreme Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Flying Car Extreme Simulator combines road driving with airborne travel. Steer through the city, drift on streets, or activate the car's flight mode to take it above the roads. Perform aerial flips while keeping clear of buildings and other potential collisions.

pages.title: Fun Fair Jigsaw
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Assemble amusement-park scenes in Fun Fair Jigsaw. Choose one of twelve pictures, then select a difficulty setting before putting the scattered pieces back together. Three difficulty options let you change the challenge while working toward the finished fairground illustration.

pages.title: Frogger
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Frogger challenges you to move animals across roads without getting hit. Use WASD or the arrow keys to guide each crossing, watching for traffic and other obstacles. Keep the animals moving safely while trying to improve the score from your previous attempt.

pages.title: Sweet Candy World
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Connect matching sweets in Sweet Candy World. Draw a chain through candies of the same type to remove them from the board. The puzzle is built around spotting groups you can link together, using its assortment of candy, jelly, and cookie pieces.

pages.title: Tractor Trial
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Take a tractor over rough terrain in Tractor Trial. Drive past obstacles and traps while keeping the vehicle balanced as the ground rises and falls. The challenge comes from controlling its weight as well as getting it across each off-road course.

pages.title: Little City Difference
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Compare paired town pictures in Little City Difference. Locate seven differences before the one-minute timer runs out, then move on to another scene. Ten levels give you new details to inspect as you look for changes between otherwise similar images.

pages.title: Shoot Em Up
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Fight approaching zombies in Shoot Em Up. Keep attacking the undead as they close in, using the keyboard controls to handle the action. Your immediate objective is to kill the zombies coming toward you before their advance overwhelms your position.

pages.title: Ear Doctor
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Treat patients' ears in Ear Doctor, a medical simulation controlled with the mouse. Work through the available treatment tasks as an ear specialist. Select and use the tools provided for each patient's condition to complete the examination and care sequence.

pages.title: Snow Fall Racing Championship
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Race sports cars through a snowy setting in Snow Fall Racing Championship. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys as you compete for the championship. The focus is on controlling your car through the wintry race course and finishing ahead of the competition.

pages.title: Halloween Chess
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Halloween Chess gives the board game a seasonal set of spooky pieces and three visual themes. Play as white or black, choose a computer difficulty, or face another player. A hint system offers guidance while you plan moves and try to checkmate the opposing king.

pages.title: Funny Crazy Runner
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Run as far as you can in Funny Crazy Runner while gathering coins and food. Jump past cars and tires, but stay clear of bombs along the road. Your score depends on continuing the run and collecting rewards without landing on a dangerous obstacle.

pages.title: Fun Monsters Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Reassemble cartoon creature pictures in Fun Monsters Jigsaw. Select an image and choose a puzzle with 25, 49, or 100 pieces. Fit the scattered sections together to complete the monster scene, adjusting the difficulty when you want a different level of detail.

pages.title: Metro Bus Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Carry passengers through urban streets and hilly routes in Metro Bus Simulator. Drive a long bus to pickup points and deliver its passengers to their destinations. Watch your speed around traffic and use the handbrake when needed to keep the journey under control.

pages.title: Elf Defence
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Build a defensive force in Elf Defence by collecting elves and merging identical ones. Combine matching units as you prepare to protect their home. The game links gathering defenders with improving the force available to hold back the threats against it.

pages.title: BTS Vegy Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Vegy Coloring Book offers vegetable-themed pictures to color. Choose a drawing and add color to its outlined areas, building your own version of the illustration. Mouse or touch input lets you work through the picture at your own pace.

pages.title: Balloon Pop
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Throw darts at floating targets in Balloon Pop. Click or tap to launch each dart and try to strike the balloons. The game centers on lining up your throws and watching whether they connect with the targets you want to burst.

pages.title: Mango Piggy Piggy vs Bad Veggies
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Bounce through vegetable opponents in Mango Piggy Piggy vs Bad Veggies. Knock away the boss first, then extend the run by hitting more enemies and collecting power-ups. Gather mango points along the way and spend them on upgrades for subsequent attempts.

pages.title: Stickman Bridge Constructor
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Help a stick-figure worker span gaps in Stickman Bridge Constructor. Build a succession of bridges so the character can continue onward. The game centers on constructing a usable crossing each time, making the next gap another test of your bridge-building judgment.

pages.title: Big Farm Link
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Big Farm Link is a timed matching puzzle featuring fruit and vegetables. Draw connections between matching produce to make the required patterns. Search the board and complete links before the time runs out, choosing your next matches from the remaining pieces.

pages.title: Escape Plane
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Evade waves of missiles in Escape Plane. Fly through enemy territory while attacks try to bring your aircraft down. The flight continues for as long as you survive, making evasive movement and keeping clear of incoming weapons the main challenge.

pages.title: Snake Battle
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Guide a snake around a shared arena in Snake Battle. Collect food to build your score while competing against other snakes. The game tracks kills and points, giving you competing targets as you work toward a place on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Guess Who Multiplayer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Identify your opponent's hidden character in Guess Who Multiplayer. Ask questions to narrow the possibilities and try to name the correct person first. Choose a multiplayer match or play against the computer, selecting questions through the game's character-guessing interface.

pages.title: Jenner Halloween Face Art
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Create a Halloween party look in Jenner Halloween Face Art. Help Jenner prepare by applying the available face-art choices and coordinating their details. Use the mouse to work through the makeover and build a finished design for the themed celebration.

pages.title: Pirates! The Match 3
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description: Pirates! The Match 3 combines gem swapping with a pirate voyage. Match rows or columns to complete tasks such as uncovering treasure, opening chests, and battling enemies. Longer matches create special gems, which can be combined into stronger pieces for later moves.

pages.title: Stickman Archer 4
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight enemies with ranged weapons in Stickman Archer 4. Aim your bow before opponents can kill you, or try the firearm combat in MRgun mode. Earn diamonds to expand your arsenal and choose from three modes that change how the stick-figure battles unfold.

pages.title: BALLS IMPACT
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: BALLS IMPACT is a physics puzzle about releasing balls at useful angles. Adjust the direction of your shots and use their movement to earn stars and points. The level layouts change the problem, giving you new arrangements to solve with each set of launches.

pages.title: Christmas Pong
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Defend your side of the court in Christmas Pong. Move the paddle vertically to return the ball and send it past the opposing paddle to score. Play alone or against another person, with the running totals shown above the holiday-themed playfield.

pages.title: Kawaii Wedding Cake
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Design a miniature wedding dessert in Kawaii Wedding Cake. Choose a cake flavor and build a decorated look for the reception. Experiment with the available design choices to make a small, characterful centerpiece that fits the wedding style you have in mind.

pages.title: Baby Princess Halloween
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Dress young princesses for a costume party in Baby Princess Halloween. Choose themed dresses, hats, masks, and other accessories for the different characters. Mix the available pieces into Halloween outfits and give each guest a distinct look for the celebration.

pages.title: Dont Destroy the Ball
pages.creator: Erigatohishima
pages.description: Keep a bouncing ball away from spikes in Dont Destroy the Ball. Move around the play area and collect hearts while avoiding dangerous surfaces. The challenge is to continue gathering hearts without letting the ball touch a spike and end the attempt.

pages.title: College Crush Date
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Help Emily get ready for romance in College Crush Date. Start with facial treatments and cosmetics, then choose an outfit for her meeting. Prepare a setting where the college couple can sneak kisses, bringing beauty care, dressing, and the date into one sequence.

pages.title: Doodle Car
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Reveal classic automobiles in Doodle Car by adjusting the image's position. Drag and rotate the view until the car becomes clear enough to recognize. The puzzle centers on finding the right perspective, turning an unclear arrangement into a recognizable three-dimensional vehicle.

pages.title: Avie Pocket: Popstar
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Help Avie prepare for pop stardom in Avie Pocket: Popstar. Customize her hair, makeup, clothing, and accessories, then take part in activities such as matching pairs and dancing. The game combines a changeable stage look with several music-themed minigames.

pages.title: Elsa Online Dating
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help a princess arrange a date in Elsa Online Dating. Browse possible matches, check compatibility, and choose a partner before preparing their outfits. Dress both characters for the meeting by combining clothing, shoes, and accessories from the available wardrobes.

pages.title: Supermodels Perfect Nails
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Give three models coordinated beauty treatments in Supermodels Perfect Nails. Work through manicures and pedicures, trying different polish colors and nail decorations. Choose hairstyles as well, then compare combinations until each model has a finished look that suits her nails.
